convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load external indicator 'LinearRegSlope_V1' with custom smoothing algorithms from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, and trade execution from TradeAlgorithms.mqh - both external .mqh libraries affecting trading logic

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed before EA trades
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input flags can disable signal-based closes; BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose from TradeAlgorithms.mqh handle actual close execution

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative value = fixed lot size (absolute value, e.g. -0.1 means 0.1 lots); positive value = deposit fraction for lot calculation. This is handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: 1. Signal detection uses previous bar [1] vs bar-before-that [0] from CopyBuffer with SignalBar offset - comparing UpValue[1]>DnValue[1] for current state and UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0] for prior state to detect crossover. 2. Conflicting signals (both BUY_Open and SELL_Open true simultaneously) cancel all signals - prevents whipsaw entries. 3. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen and BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean input toggles allowing selective enable/disable of each trade direction and action. 4. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions which likely handle position checks, lot sizing (MM parameter logic), and order placement internally. 5. LoadHistory() call ensures history data is available before signal calculation. 6. Recount flag triggers recalculation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: 1. The LinearRegSlope_V1 custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it uses linear regression slope with configurable smoothing (SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh. The JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA smoothing methods are non-trivial to port. 2. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GetStartBars) must be reimplemented - they likely contain position management, MM lot sizing logic (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction), and order execution with deviation handling. 3. Signal crossover logic compares indicator buffers at bars [1] vs [0] with a SignalBar offset, meaning the actual comparison is between bar (SignalBar+1) and bar (SignalBar). 4. SL/TP values (1000/2000) appear to be in points not pips - no digit adjustment logic is visible but the large values suggest they may already account for 5-digit brokers or are in raw points. Verify during conversion. 5. The mutually exclusive signal check (both BUY_Open and SELL_Open cancels all) must be preserved exactly. 6. Signal timing uses SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec which approximates next bar open time.
